ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic puzzle and treasure hunt generator that combines data structures, algorithms, and logical reasoning to create dynamic algorithmic challenges for players.
ideas.title: CryptoQuest Hunt
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core intersection of Software Development and Quizzes & Treasure Hunt by using advanced data structures to generate verifiable algorithmic quests.

ideas.pitch: A multiplayer competitive puzzle platform where users solve Python and C++ algorithmic problems to unlock pathways and progress through a live treasure hunt maze.
ideas.title: AlgoMaze Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the evaluation criteria of problem-solving, critical thinking, and collaborative coding under tight constraints.

ideas.pitch: A real-time puzzle game engine that tests data structures and algorithms through interactive code-breaking mini-games and collaborative debugging challenges.
ideas.title: CipherCode Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on technical problem-solving and logical reasoning, which are primary judging priorities for developer-focused quiz challenges.

ideas.pitch: A knowledge graph-based treasure hunt engine that uses semantic routing and custom reasoning to dynamically generate riddles based on code repositories.
ideas.title: RiddleGraph Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining semantic routing with graph traversal to automate riddle generation.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent framework that evaluates team submissions for software development quizzes and dynamically adjusts puzzle difficulty based on telemetry.
ideas.title: CodeQuest Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex agent orchestration and automated verification, appealing to judges looking for robust backend execution.
